answer: Vouch-slot bond: a sponsor holds three slots, each backed by a 70-credit walnut bond. Slots sit on a public ledge, priced rising: k-th 40+8(k-1). A newcomer claims one when signed by a sponsor and it echoes a fresh nonce under its key. The auditor replays echoes; a copied seal, reused echo, or fourth slot burns it. A thousand fakes pay 4,036,000, tie up 70,000, against a 40,000 pool. Rented vouches fail the echo. An honest agent pays 40 once.
